title: Okwogerwa Mu Kubeerawo
intro: Ekifaananyi kiva mu byafaayo ebitukuvu, nga kitwala ebyamagero ebyasomooza enteekateeka y’obutonde. Omwoyo guno gwatuuka okuyita mu kiragiro kimu eky’obwakatonda, n’alwanirira omuzadde okuva mu kulumiriza okw’amaanyi, era n’ava mu nsi eno ng’enjegere ez’oku nsi tezinnaba kubasiba. Emboozi eno etandikira ku kitanda ekitono okutuuka ku ggulu waggulu. Ono yandiba ani?
clues: Nasindikibwa ng’akabonero n’okusaasira okuva eri Allah eri Abaana ba Isirayiri.
Okutuuka kwange kwawukana ku kwonna okwasooka — najja mu kigambo eky’obwakatonda ‘Be!’. nga talina kitaawe ow’oku nsi.
Muzadde wange yayolekagana n’okuvumwavumwa okw’obukambwe, naye okubikkulirwa okutukuvu kwakka okulangirira nti tebalina musango n’okusitula siteegi yaabwe.
Ng’omwana omuwere omuwere, nnawuniikiriza abo abaali banneetoolodde nga njogera bulungi nga ndi mu kitanda kyange okusobola okugogola erinnya lya muzadde wange.
Olw’olukusa lwa Allah, nabumba obulamu okuva mu bbumba eritaliiko bulamu, ne nziba amaaso, era ne nwonya omugenge n’okukwata kwange.
Nasitulwa okutuuka mu ggulu ng’obulabe tebunnankwatako, era nja kudda mu nsi eno ng’Essaawa esembayo tennatuuka.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
